name: rty-devops-toolkit
description: DevOps automation toolkit — deploy workflows, database migrations, secrets scanning, infrastructure auditing, and incident response runbooks with AI-guided steps.

interface.shortDescription: AI-guided DevOps automation for deploy, DB, secrets, infra, and incidents.
interface.longDescription: A comprehensive DevOps toolkit plugin providing five AI-guided skills: deploy-workflow for release automation, database-migrations for schema change management, secrets-scanner for credential leak detection, infrastructure-audit for compliance checks, and incident-response for structured runbooks. Bundles lifecycle hooks and an audit agent.
